name: sol-advisor
description: Sol-led capability router: plan with GPT-5.6 Sol / High, delegate easy-medium implementation to Luna / Max, medium-hard to Terra / High, hard-complex to a separate Sol / High worker, then require a fresh Sol review.

interface.shortDescription: Plan with Sol; route execution through Luna, Terra, or Sol; finish with fresh Sol review.
interface.longDescription: GPT-5.6 Sol / High owns planning and routing. Native implementation defaults to GPT-5.6 Luna / Max for easy-to-medium work, escalates to GPT-5.6 Terra / High for medium-to-hard work, and uses a separate GPT-5.6 Sol / High implementation context for hard-to-complex work. The primary verifies the actual diff and a fresh requested-read-only Sol / High reviewer must approve completion.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Advisor to plan with Sol / High and route this implementation through the lowest capable lane.
Prefer Luna for bounded work, escalate to Terra or Sol only when implementation complexity requires it.
Verify the diff and obtain a fresh Sol / High review before reporting completion.
